summary: Cross-platform Rust rewrite of GNU coreutils, providing familiar command-line utilities across Linux, macOS, and Windows with enhanced performance and compatibility.
usecases: Replacing GNU coreutils on Linux/macOS/Windows for better performance and compatibility
Providing a lightweight, cross-platform alternative to GNU coreutils and BusyBox for embedded systems
Serving as a direct replacement for core utilities on modern OSes with enhanced compatibility
ideas: Port to Windows and macOS as a drop-in replacement for GNU coreutils
Integrate with embedded systems for IoT edge computing
Add GUI-friendly flags or scripts for developer workflow automation
